alternatives.name: quantstats
alternatives.why_not_default: It has no execution evidence. The packet's evidence_kind is source_review. The card limitation says the 'Prospective workflow is unexecuted'. A Grep of blueprints/, fixtures/ and tests/ matched only tests/test_sota_convergence.py, where lines 670-691 are manifest-schema assertions with evidence_level 'source_review'. The repository mentions quantstats elsewhere, but only in catalogs and records, not execution evidence. catalogs/us-equities/engines-strategies.md:82 and evidence/artifacts/claude-repository-evidence-20260921/results.json:7283 make it the Default report renderer. Its role, return/risk reports, falls under the layer's performance-evaluation scope term and complements the c3 splitter rather than competing with it. It stays conditional, not default, because per the packet's card limitation a tear sheet is descriptive and 'does not fix leakage, trial selection, poor fills or accounting errors', and because it has never run here. This verdict departs from the catalog's Default ranking on evidence-class grounds only.

alternatives.name: cvxportfolio
alternatives.why_not_default: It has no execution evidence. catalogs/us-equities/engines-strategies.json:870 gives evidence_level 'source_review', and :875 labels the native workflow '# Prospective and unexecuted'. The workflow example deliberately uses no costs (:881). Grep found no blueprint or fixture that installs or runs it. The card warns that the forward-aligned return convention can leak future information and that 'optimizer feasibility is not execution feasibility'. Its license is GPL-3.0-or-later (:867). Its multi-period, cost-aware role is distinct from the splitter, but no measured comparison shows it closes a gap on the frozen inputs.

alternatives.name: empyrical-reloaded
alternatives.why_not_default: It has no execution evidence. The packet's evidence_kind is source_review, and the card says the 'Prospective workflow is unexecuted'. In blueprints/, fixtures/ and tests/, the only match is a comment at tests/test_sota_convergence.py:1952. Other mentions are in catalogs and records, not execution evidence. Its metric-function role overlaps c4's reporting role. It shares the 'empyrical' import namespace with the legacy package. The packet's review_status is 'unmaintained_signal', and upstream was last pushed on 2025-12-12.

open_gaps: No candidate has native evidence for the layer's portfolio-optimization, performance-evaluation or legacy-metrics scope terms. skfolio's native evidence covers only WalkForward on a raw-price label study: evaluate.py:181-183 and README 'This accepts the splitter used here, not every skfolio optimizer'.

No adopted candidate has observed evidence of deterministic numeric risk enforcement, reproducible equity accounting or broker reconciliation within NautilusTrader, which the layer requirement asks for.
The skfolio pin 1.2.9 is behind upstream v1.3.0 (released 2026-09-20), and 1.3.0 is unqualified.
The receipt's cost proxy does not model fills, commissions, funding, turnover netting or liquidity, and there is no dividend or cash reconciliation.
There are few reserved episodes per candidate, and the reserved segment has been inspected, so no statistical advantage is established.
cvxportfolio, empyrical-reloaded and quantstats have no installation or execution evidence in blueprints/, fixtures/ or tests/.
Native acceptance covers only the Linux/WSL Python 3.13.15 environment.
This verdict does not follow the catalog ranking, where quantstats is Default and skfolio is 'Conditional beyond accepted scope'. The difference has not been resolved by an executed comparison.

arms: c3 skfolio 1.2.9 (WalkForward plus an optimizer or risk estimator)
c1 cvxportfolio 1.5.1 multi-period policy with an explicit USDOLLAR cash column
c2 empyrical-reloaded 0.5.12 metrics on local arrays
c4 quantstats 0.0.81 report on the same return series
overturn_protocol.metric: Native exit status and passing focused tests on the frozen plan, plus reproducible portfolio or risk outputs (weights, cost-inclusive returns, drawdown and volatility) that match an independent recomputation, with cash and dividend accounting reconciled

overturn_when: The verdict changes if an executed comparison on the same frozen inputs, blueprints/us-equities/research-evaluation/plan.json with the hash-locked requirements.lock, shows either of these: (a) cvxportfolio's multi-period cost-aware policy, or empyrical-reloaded or quantstats metrics, produce reproducible, independently recomputed portfolio or risk outputs that the skfolio path lacks; or (b) a skfolio optimizer or risk estimator fails native acceptance. That comparison needs a recorded run of blueprints/us-equities/research-evaluation/evaluate.py extended with those arms, plus 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_evaluation.py -q' passing. A regression of that focused test below 12 passed would also reopen the verdict.
sources_read: Grep quantstats|empyrical|cvxportfolio in {blueprints,fixtures,tests}/** (1 file: tests/test_sota_convergence.py) and repository-wide excluding evidence/ (21 files, all catalogs, docs, recipes, tools, observability or tests)
why_selected: skfolio (c3) is the only adopted candidate with retained native execution evidence, but that evidence covers one function: the WalkForward splitter. It does not cover the layer's portfolio-optimization, performance-evaluation or legacy-metrics scope terms, and no candidate has native evidence for those. blueprints/us-equities/research-evaluation/evaluate.py:181-183 is the only place skfolio is used. It imports skfolio.model_selection.WalkForward and requires installed version 1.2.9. The receipt (kind "native_cli_e2e", status "accepted_for_causal_raw_price_label_control_only", observed_utc 2026-09-19T22:59:04Z) records WalkForward 252/63/6 with reduce_test=True on Python 3.13.15. The run produced 20 development folds, 21 frozen selections and 6605 candidate records. Its recorded acceptance commands are "focused-tests" (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_evaluation.py -q; exit 0, "12 passed") and "full-tests" (exit 0, "214 passed, 0 skipped"), at receipt.json lines 1562-1589. The receipt's independent review reports 42 private artifact hashes verified with 0 mismatches. README.md says: "This accepts the splitter used here, not every skfolio optimizer." The same file says the labels are not portfolio P&L. The packet's external c3 ref is the v1.2.8 README, while the pin and the executed wheel are 1.2.9. catalogs/us-equities/engines-strategies.md:85 reconciles the two as "1.2.9 accepted splitter; 1.2.8 earlier review". This verdict departs from the repository's catalog ranking. engines-strategies.md:82 makes quantstats the Default and :85 makes skfolio "Conditional beyond accepted scope". The packet withheld those decisions, and I rank c3 first only because it alone has observed execution. This is a narrow winner, not proof of fitness for the whole layer. quantstats (c4) is kept as a conditional complement for reporting.
